slides.title: Prof on leave? Is there class or not?
Don't trust the corridor rumour
slides.body: "Sir is on leave" from the last bench is not a confirmation. Check before you plan that canteen trip.

slides.title: Check your timetable, not the batch group
slides.body: A class that's moved, handed over or cancelled shows up in your timetable. Look there first.

slides.title: Behind the scenes: no class left hanging
slides.caption: When a teacher's leave is approved, their classes land on a 'needs cover' list. A substitute is assigned, or the class is cancelled.

slides.title: Substitute period? Still a real class
slides.body: Show up. Your attendance cut-off doesn't care about rumours.

slides.title: Cancelled period? Plan it
slides.body: Library, that pending assignment, or a Maggi break. Your call, just don't waste it scrolling.

slides.title: Save this for the next 'sir is on leave' rumour
slides.body: Tag your college. 30-day free trial for colleges, no card needed.
